preconditions.condition: A non-stick pad covers the burn area
preconditions.source_reference: Cover the burn with a non-stick pad

postconditions.condition: A gauze roll wraps the non-stick pad over the burn
postconditions.source_reference: wrap it loosely with a gauze roll

review_notes: Visual confirmation of the gauze roll wrap is possible, though loose application is subjective and excluded.
Requirement A9_P1 ensures the previous step's object is correctly positioned.
Manual completion is false as the physical state of the wrap is verifiable.
Rubbing constraints and blister status are excluded as they concern past/internal status.
Loose wrapping is excluded as a subjective qualitative standard.
Manual completion for A9 is set to false because the presence of the wrapping gauze is a visually verifiable state.
